title: How the Printing Press Changed the World
paragraphs: A long time ago, people wrote books by hand. It was very slow. One book took many months. Books were very expensive.
In about 1450, a man in Germany made a new machine. His name was Johannes Gutenberg. The machine was a printing press.
The press used small metal letters. Workers put the letters in lines. Then the machine printed many pages fast.
Books became cheaper. More people could buy them. More people learned to read. New ideas went to many countries.
